description.narrative: Strategic Objective 1.1.: Promote the gradual improvement of the quality of service provision and increase speed procedure in the various areas of intervention of the Administrative Court. Strategic Objective 1.2.: Expand the scope of the Administrative Court's action in sectors of activity key to the development of the country. Strategic Objective 1.3.: Improve control of public finance management.

Stöd till uppbyggnad av riksrevisionen Tribunal Administrativo mellan åren 2016-2019 i Mocambique, via en givargemensam fond. Den strategiska plan PLACOR III som ligger till grund för stödet omfattar utbildning av revisorer, finansiering av revision, aktiviteter för ökad transparens, förbättrat IT-system samt revidering av lagar och förordningar.

Support for consolidation of the Supreme Audit Institution, called Tribunal Administrativo, in Mozambique, via a common fund, for the years 2016 - 2919. The support is based on the strategic plan PLACOR III entailing training of auditors, financing of audit activities, activities for improved transparency, improved IT-system, and revision of laws and regulations.

In most cases TA complied with set goals or executed more than 50% of the activities planned in different goals/areas of its activities. All planned audits were carried out, a total of 380 audits, covering 50 percent of the state budget.
1) Improvement of quality for services
TA started its activities in 2019 with 436 active contentious cases. It received an additional 151 cases during the year, bringing the total number of contentious cases in 2019 to a total of 587. Out of the 587 cases in the court, only 85 cases were finalized leaving a total of 502 cases by the time the reporting period ended. Overall, it seems there was an increase from 436 cases when the court started in 2019 to 502 cases that transited (i.e. a backlog) to the next reporting period.
2) Audits
TA has been carrying out all the audits planned for during the reporting period. 380 audits were done. In accordance, TA carried out more than 75% of the audits planned in different sectors of the state administration. Despite positive developments, few audits were planned in relation to the activities of Central institutions of the State (Ambito Central).
3) Promotion of transparency in public management
- During the reporting period TA sent 134 documents for publication in the Boletim da Republica, the official Government publication. - 200 applications/cases uploaded in the TA website. It should be highlighted that not all documents sent by TA for publication on BR have been published.
4) Strengthening relations and seek synergies with other national and international institutions that contribute towards the control of public administration, transparency and good management of public funds
External support remains unpredictable despite many development partners interest in the area. The main challenge is that there are no national stakeholders and particularly academic institutions involved in providing TA with the assistance needed for it to improve technical aspects.
5) Develop mechanism to reinforce the integrated internal control system within the Administrative Court and promote efficient, transparent and integral management making the Court a reference within the Public Administration Bodies
The internal control and auditing unit has carried out several activities to ensure TA leads by example. Among these, since 2018, the Internal Control and auditing Unit started the development of Rules and Procedures for Internal Control.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
